title: Research: present-head flag 0 Y34 span/dirty-restoration — arrive@3500, 15/15 head-free (no new kappa)
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Bounded follow-up under priority revision 6 filling the flag-0 slot left open by [#3451](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3451) / [#3456](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3456) on the present-head dirty-restoration chronology.

On published present-head flag 0 (`X0` → `Y34`, basis head `232`), the head enters `Y34`'s frame, listed and in GF(2) span, only at `Y34`'s terminal transport after-frame (event **3500**). All **15/15** `Y34` adds (last at event 3369) run in head-free charts. Beyond open [#3575](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3575)'s literal relay cut (591→3500):

- Span-level hosting: zero source span drops (22/22 `X0` annotations span `232`); zero preterminal `Y34` span hosting (`preterminal_span_hosting=0`).
- Target-update chronology: 15/15 `Y34` row updates head-free; 0 `Y34` events after first span co-hosting.
- Frame semantics: all 11 endpoint transports nested upward; paid rank equals rank increase.
- Listing vs span conflict with #3575: at event 3500, `X0` does not *list* `232` on the coordinate basis yet still *spans* it (`8^32^64^128`); dirty-restoration obstruction is target-side.

No `Y34` event occurs while both endpoints host the head direction, so chronological dirty restoration cannot use co-hosted basis-head geometry on this coefficient-cascade target ahead of the published `I−G/2` tail add.

**No new kappa.** Selected κ stays `0.001672660197076918`. No `I−G/2` rank-mass pricing; no tail pricing at 5759.

Side-correction bills #3601/#3610/#3614/#3618/#3621 untouched.

## Validation

```sh
python3.12 -I -B research/p104-present-head-flag0-audit/verify.py
python3.12 -I -O -Werror -B research/p104-present-head-flag0-audit/verify.py
python3.12 -I -O -Werror -B research/p104-present-head-flag0-audit/independent.py
python3.12 -I -O -Werror -B research/p104-present-head-flag0-audit/test_package.py
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-present-head-flag0-audit
```

Expected:

```text
PASS_P104_PRESENT_HEAD_FLAG0 flag=0 head=232 preterminal_hosting=0 preterminal_span_hosting=0 drop_event=591 arrive_event=3500 source_span_drops=0 head_free_target_updates=15/15 no_new_kappa
PASS_P104_PRESENT_HEAD_FLAG0_INDEPENDENT flag=0 head=232 preterminal_hosting=0 preterminal_span_hosting=0 drop_event=591 arrive_event=3500 source_span_drops=0 head_free_target_updates=15/15 no_new_kappa
PASS_P104_PRESENT_HEAD_FLAG0_TESTS groups=6
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/p104-present-head-flag0-audit outcome=completed
```

Default verify is read-only. Admission uses `need()` and still fires under `-O`.

## Open next questions

1. Can a changed schedule bring `232` into `Y34`'s span before the add at event 3369, while `X0` is still live, and what does that add to the channel bill ahead of event 5759?
2. Does the published promote/add/restore at 5758/5759/5807 admit an owner/host schedule for the `X0` read that restores arbitrary dirt without repaying the unrestored channel endpoints?
